adapter_semantics: fs.rm/unlink/rmdir sync, callback, promises and named ESM exports rename into same-device quarantine. Missing force/ENOENT, unlink-directory, rmdir-file/nonempty directory checks were smoke-tested. This does not reproduce every OS race, recursive per-child permission error, invalid-option check, or native non-Node cleanup. It never uses copy+delete for EXDEV. No product dependency was added.
cleanup_call_inspection: package script invokes node --test serially. Inspected scripts/runtime/modules/tests and task4 runner: Node cleanup operations are intercepted; process children are Node, FFmpeg/FFprobe or Chromium. No external shell rm/unlink/rmdir invocation was found. Native Chromium intentionally unavailable.
baseline_outputs: All original scope files copied externally before tests. No original evidence bytes changed during baseline run. Final run left tracked artifact bytes at the checked path-reference commit; only README/.gitignore/new organization evidence were independently edited.
